bf-caa70e3baca7a39a1870cb92.what: Nested authentication activation deadlocks on the parent's SQLite permit
bf-caa70e3baca7a39a1870cb92.root_cause: ManagedRuntime builds authLiveLayer in a new fiber. inheritNativeLeases previously wrapped only the post-acquisition operation, so acquisition waited on the SQLite permit retained by its awaiting parent
bf-caa70e3baca7a39a1870cb92.fixed_by: Build the auth layer inside an acquisition-only inheritNativeLeases effect using Layer.effectContext and Layer.build; keep ephemeral leases out of the returned service context

bf-64e1972ee751d5a45e3ef3b8.what: Better Auth endpoints were absent from Scalar, preventing discovery of login before using authenticated todos.
bf-64e1972ee751d5a45e3ef3b8.root_cause: packages/runtime-hono/src/api-docs.ts served only the graph-derived application document. The raw Better Auth catch-all handler did not contribute its native endpoint schemas, and the generated auth runtime supplied session lookup only.
bf-64e1972ee751d5a45e3ef3b8.fixed_by: Added lazy native Better Auth schema generation, mounted paths and isolated schema names, merged it into authorized API docs, wired generated and testing auth runtimes, and added same-origin login instructions. Verified browser signup/login and todo CRUD with session cookies.
